name: Voice R-7 hosted credential, spend, tenant and engine boundaries incl. hosted LiveKit (Phone) on app.papercusp.com (portal e2e, 2026-10-06 run 4)
command: node ./.papercusp/scratch/r7-run4-launch.mjs  # reads /proc/<pid>/environ of papercusp-cloud-portal.service + papercusp-phone-sidecar.service (MainPID + children); exports each secret-shaped name (KEY|SECRET|TOKEN|PASSWORD|DATABASE_URL, minus *_REF/*_FILE/PUBLIC/PUBLISHABLE/*_ID, value >= 12 chars) as PORTAL_VOICE_BOUNDARIES_SECRET__<NAME> and lists the names in PORTAL_VOICE_BOUNDARIES_SECRET_ENV (values never printed); then, in ~/.papercusp-workspaces/papercusp-workspace/.papercusp/apps/portal: PORTAL_VOICE_BOUNDARIES_E2E=1 PORTAL_VOICE_BOUNDARIES_EVIDENCE_OUT=.papercusp/scratch/r7-boundaries-run4-receipt.json npx playwright test e2e/portal-voice-hosted-boundaries.spec.ts --reporter=list  # log .papercusp/scratch/r7-boundaries-run4.log (STARTED, PORTAL_HEAD, PORTAL_DIRTY, HOSTED_UNIT, SECRET_NAME, RUN_EXIT, HOSTED_UNIT_STABLE, FINISHED)
summary: portal/e2e/portal-voice-hosted-boundaries.spec.ts ran against the live hosted portal (https://app.papercusp.com) through the canonical portal playwright.config.ts with three freshly admitted TEST tenants: 4 passed, 0 failed, exit 0. Unauthenticated: /api/voice/elevenlabs/token 401; /api/voice/engines 401; /api/papercup-chat/conversations/boundary-probe/voice-session 401, no token minted. Engines advertised exactly {"elevenlabs":false,"livekit":true}. Retired /api/device/voice/turn GET+POST 404. Browser-delivered bodies scanned for secret patterns (38 responses, 2263893 bytes, twice): 0 findings. Tenant A start burst: 6 x 404 no-agent-id (hosted ElevenLabs fails closed, unconfigured per D-007), then 429 portal_voice_start_rate_limited Retry-After 60. Tenant B after A's burst: 404 no-agent-id (not throttled). Hosted LiveKit (Phone, /api/phone): unauthenticated call 401 with no grant; tenant A's spent budget refuses a LiveKit start too (429 portal_voice_start_rate_limited); a chat id tenant B does not own 404 portal_chat_not_found; tenants B and C each got a grant (200/200) with distinct room, token and LiveKit identity, each JWT room claim matching its grant; tenant C could not list (absent), export (404) or end (404 phone_call_not_found) B's room; both rooms ended (200/200). Exact-value secret compare: 14 hosted secret values (DEEPGRAM_API_KEY, ELEVEN_API_KEY, HARNESS_ADMIN_DATABASE_URL, OPENROUTER_API_KEY, PAPERCUSP_CLOUD_PORTAL_SECRET_PAPERCUSP_HOSTED_SESSION_COOKIE_SECRET, PAPERCUSP_CLOUD_PORTAL_SECRET_WORKOS_API_KEY, PAPERCUSP_CLOUD_PORTAL_SECRET_WORKOS_COOKIE_PASSWORD, PAPERCUSP_CLOUD_PORTAL_SECRET_WORKOS_WEBHOOK_SECRET, PHONE_AUTH_SECRET, PHONE_LIVEKIT_API_KEY, PHONE_LIVEKIT_API_SECRET, PHONE_WORKER_SECRET, STOREWOLFKEY, STOREWOLFPASSWORD). 3 TEST users cleaned up.

disclosures: Hosted ElevenLabs has no agent id configured (hosted EL is out of release scope per D-007), so every ElevenLabs start fails closed with 404 no-agent-id before any token exists; there is no live ElevenLabs token to compare across tenants. Cross-tenant grant distinctness is measured live on the advertised hosted engine (LiveKit), and for ElevenLabs at the unit layer (portal/tests/a-shared-mint-is-not-a-shared-token.test.ts).
Scope note, not an R-7 gap: the hosted spoken round trip and browser microphone denial belong to R-2/R-3/R-4 and run in the guided real-microphone session (D-005, D-009).
